senses.en_definition: Come on; let us; used to invite someone to do something.

messages.en: Where do you wanna eat? I'm getting hungry.
Let's eat at that place in front of the station. Their chicken rice is really good.

senses.en_definition: Come; let us; used to warmly invite or urge others to take action.

messages.en: Come over for dinner tonight. I've cooked extra.
Sure, Kak! I'll bring some fruit. Is seven okay?

senses.en_definition: Time; a particular point or occasion in time.
A period of time with a beginning and an end.
A period, era, or stage in life or history.
How could ...? Surely not; used to express disbelief or ask a rhetorical question.

messages.en: Are you free tonight? Let's eat at that new tom yum place.
Yeah, but only after eight. I've got to finish my work first.
Sure. Text me when you're done. We'll go together.
Is this chicken cooked yet? I'm ready to eat.
Not yet. Just give it another five minutes.
